exposure: type of intermittent exotropia (Basic-type, Convergence insufficiency-type, Divergence excess-type)
cohort: The study included 5331 patients diagnosed with intermittent exotropia.
finding: Clinical characteristics varied significantly among different types of intermittent exotropia, with CI-type associated with older age and greater myopia, and DE-type with frequent photophobia.
cross-section timing: N/A (retrospective analysis of existing patient data)
